gamificationGuide.introText: Completing tasks earns Experience Points (XP). Level up to unlock ranks, collect rare stones, earn Shards to spend in the Marketplace, and build an unbreakable streak.
gamificationGuide.earningXpDesc: XP scales with how critical a task is. Focus on high-priority items to level up faster.
gamificationGuide.shardsMarketplaceDesc: Every stone you unearth by leveling up grants Shards — a currency you spend in the Marketplace on themes, accent colors, and fonts. Rarer stones grant far more.
gamificationGuide.streaksFreezesDesc: Open the app each day to keep your streak alive. The flame on your dashboard evolves as it grows.
gamificationGuide.streakFreezeDesc: Miss a day and the system auto-spends 500 XP per missed day to save your streak from resetting.
gamificationGuide.streakFreezeSafeDesc: When enabled, each missed day costs exactly 500 XP earned inside your current level. If the full amount is unavailable the streak resets instead, and your level and stones are never reduced.
gamificationGuide.levelProgressionDesc: Leveling up gets progressively harder. Can you reach the legendary Level 30?
